en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al Hassan Bin Salih, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
having said that Ali<sup>asws</sup> emancipated a Christian slave of his<sup>asws</sup>, so he became a Muslim when he<sup>asws</sup> emancipated him’.
